components.css: .ds-line { padding: 2rem; background: #111826; color: #e9ebf0; --ride: 1.4s; } .ds-track { position: relative; } .ds-stops { position: relative; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-stops::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0.6rem; height: 3px; background: #ffb627; opacity: 0.35; } .ds-stops li { position: relative; padding: 2rem 1rem 0 0; } .ds-stops li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #0b0f16; border: 3px solid #ffb627; box-sizing: border-box; transition: background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); transition-delay: calc(var(--i) * var(--ride) / (var(--n) - 1)); } .ds-stops strong { display: block; font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-stops p { margin: 0.4rem 0 0; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #9aa6ba; } .ds-train { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 0.3rem; left: -1.07rem; width: 3.5rem; height: 9px; border-radius: 9px; background: #ffb627; opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 2px rgb(255 182 39 / 0.6); } .ds-line:is(:hover, :focus-within, :focus-visible) .ds-stops li::before { background: #ffb627; transform: scale(1.12); } .ds-line:is(:hover, :focus-within, :focus-visible) .ds-train { animation: ds-ride var(--ride) linear forwards; } @keyframes ds-ride { 0% { left: -1.07rem; opacity: 1; } 90% { opacity: 1; } 100% { left: calc(100% * (var(--n) - 1) / var(--n) - 1.07rem); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stops li::before { transition: none; } .ds-train { animation: none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is a city after dark seen from a bridge. Blue-hour cobalt drains into tower-shadow navy; a generated skyline of lit window grids climbs the right side of the hero; one eastern facade has turned silver before dawn; below the bridge a wet street throws the lights back as long blurred streaks. Work is drawn as transit: a project is a line, its stations are the real path a request takes, and sodium-lamp yellow is the electricity running through it.

Density is low and vertical. Big condensed caps carry the structure, quiet tracked labels carry the wayfinding, and Overpass (a highway-signage descendant) carries the reading. Everything is flat and square-cornered except the transit hardware, which is round, and the light itself, which glows. All imagery is code: deterministic SVG from a seeded generator, so the same city renders on every visit.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground in three tones (cobalt sky, night, tower shadow) with one warm accent.
Thin-to-semibold condensed display caps against a sans body.
Transit lines as the reusable structural device: rail, round stations, numbered bullets.
Light behaves like light: sodium glows, windows bleed, reflections blur vertically.
Square, flat surfaces; depth comes from tone and light, not cards.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Sodium is the only accent. If something is clickable, active or emphasized, it is sodium; nothing else competes for that job.

rules.name: The Light Source Rule
rules.body: Blue and silver appear as things that emit or reflect light in the city (windows, the facade, the name). They do not become UI states.

rules.name: The Caps Signage Rule
rules.body: Every display-face setting is uppercase. Big Shoulders never sets sentence case.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hero and section headings are thin (300); anything that names a thing (line, role, station) is semibold (600). Size never substitutes for that split.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Clocks and dates use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Only Light Glows Rule
rules.body: A shadow exists only where sodium light is emitted. Neutral surfaces never get drop shadows.

dos: **Do** route every interactive, active or emphasized state through sodium (#ffb627); hover, focus, selection and lit stations all use it.
**Do** set display type in uppercase Big Shoulders, 300 for headings and 600 for names of things.
**Do** express structure as transit: rails, ring stations, numbered bullets, timetable rows.
**Do** generate imagery in code with a fixed seed so the city is identical on server and client.
**Do** give every motion a static fallback under prefers-reduced-motion and a lit-by-default state under hover: none.
**Do** use the house ease (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for lifts, slides and station fills.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second accent; window blue and dawn silver are light sources, not UI colors.
**Don't** round buttons, bands or containers; radius belongs to stations, bullets and the train.
**Don't** add drop shadows to neutral surfaces or wrap content in cards; depth is tone and light.
**Don't** set Big Shoulders in sentence case or use it for running text.
**Don't** let lit windows sit behind reading copy; keep the city low under the text column.
